name: ctrl-repo-hub
description: Electron application to manage and clone accessible GitHub and Azure DevOps repositories.

scripts.dev:electron: wait-on dist/main/main.js tcp:5173 && nodemon --watch dist/main --ext js --exec "cross-env ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.dev:electron:debug: wait-on dist/main/main.js tcp:5173 && nodemon --watch dist/main --ext js --exec "cross-env ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron --inspect=9229 ."
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
